title: world protocol — wire profile
description: How a consumer must read a document that arrives from somewhere else. A component this version does not know is carried and ignored, and so is an unknown field inside a component it does know — that is not leniency for its own sake, it is SPEC §9's forward-compatibility rule, and it is what lets one team ship a component without negotiating with every other consumer. What this profile does insist on is the part a consumer acts upon: record kinds, identities and addresses, references, closed enums, and the fields a known component cannot work without.
$comment: Validate anything you did not write against this profile, and what you are writing against the authoring profile as well. This file is deliberately thin: the shared shape is the whole wire contract, and the authoring profile is that shape plus a closure.
